claim: A first provenance test -- 'a file written on D contains no date later than D' -- reported four violations and would have voided the inference. All four are forward-looking: a parking window 2026-07-01 to 2026-10-29, an ETNA deadline 2026-08-31, a JTNB cooldown to 2026-11-12. The test conflated mentioning a later date with being written later, so against a planning log it could only ever fire. It was replaced by an event-based test, not tuned, and the misfire is recorded in the output rather than dropped.
label: INSPECTED
